book.name: Kolosai
book.title: PAS PAULO MENI KOLOSAI EMARE GAENUA

content: Nena ike itia amira zewai wanekai.

Nikare Anutu meni Kristore dai betaira ena awa-uzenu eriro nuai me pumuwa awa. Ami emo nuai mera nena utura itia awa pumamu zewai inoise noiwo. Utura ena Kristo meni Tua wero Anutura nana wana mera arumuro itewia.
Dubare kotumaire nisokare awa nena zebura itia amira kota, nena ike itia amira potiu itae.

Nikare betewa ago ine inoya. Ata nuai nisokare seka awa damu-damuke oko itia. Kristo nu nuai nuso seka awa Anutura nana ena pupinowia da ago ine nikare nuai nisokare seka awa Kristora nana ena pupinowewa awa.
Noma Kristo nu nuaira mama nasokai meni kei damu nai amire nikare da ago ine numore dai simai zasimaire nusora kei damu namunowa awa.
Nuai matu doro nuai seka puro nuanekai.

Are zebura nuai matu amira duba-duba wai eure-taure nisokare nana awa musuniu tepo-tapo ware. Pasina ego ine emire tona awa: Bama bewana wai, tani waya wai, tamara duba-duba waya wai, nena waya emo duba witai, wau emo duba-duba wai. Wau emo duba-duba wai awa pasina tua opi bowi wai ago ine awa.
Pasina bamubamu ami emo Anutura nana ena ge dai emara nana ina kei awamunoya.
Nikare da ago ine gita noise pasina inoise noisowa awa.
Ata zeme meni awa pasina ego ewa dapikarago doro baitiwo: Be dumu wai, tini kapai, ge busai, ema zora zazo puro osai, ge waya-kawaya sai. Pasina ago ine awa dago doro tepo wewo.

Nikare nuai matu nisokarere tani-butani mamatu awa tama woi aso ine dutuniro doro nuai seka nisokare tama woi seka ine wosuniro puro nowewa, are opi ina-sa wai awa oko wawe. Nuai seka awa Anutu meni tamunua awa. Ago wero nakai susu nuso giro baitiro nu ine wanisekai nuai seka awa kora inowia awa.

Nakai nuai seka puro nowenakai, are zaumuro nuai awa tepo wenua awa. Ema Yudako ata Yuda ema, o ema owere ata owe tepore, o ewa ema ata ware ema, o sou wai ema ata ema mui amu. Ema susu giti awa Kristo meni nakai bamu dago te wero giti kopi nasokai wero nasokai nana nowia awa.
Utura gera nuai amira ge.

Nikare awa Anutura gegenai dubu awa. Nu nutope nimorekare dubara dumi pupinoise dubu nuso wawise siana-katana wero pumunua awa. Are nikare tani ego ewa tama woi seka ine wosuniro noiwo: Awa-diaire, dumi yagaba pumaire, duba puro osaire, wama-ozaire, ina-da wai tepore.
Nimorekare waya wara ina ge oko sawe. Ota nisokare nana soe ena ge kei awai giro ge awa dowo tepo wae. Tua meni pasina nisokare donua da ago ine pasina ina-dua wewo.
Ago wero nena bamubamu amira tame dubara dumi puro nuawa ami tani ewa-gaewa awa poti dara nai ewanana wamunoya awa.

Nikare begare duba-ozaire Kristo meni puro munua awa puro nuawise Anutu meni nikare zawa sero poti dara ninu te-wana tama ipu da ine wero nowewa awa. Are begare duba-ozaire ami refri ine wero duba nisokare dia waise. Nikare kokopai Anuture toise noiwo.

Kristora ge meni nisokare nana soe ena zamaise. Nikare kotumai bamure noise ge ina-gipa wero ina-sorema wewo. Ago wero Anuture kokopai toise yere eure taure — Samta yereta koka Ozana meni nimorekare potitinowia — yere awa bere kotumaire meni gapinoise noiwo.
Nikare ge menita wana meni nena wamu wero giro awa Tua Yesura nana ereniro amire wewo. Ago inoise Anutu Mamere kokopai toise noiwo.
Iu ara, ata mia mama, ata mai awiso amira ge.
O bama mamai, nikare ibana nisokarera ge dipinoise noiwo. Tuara gegenai sai meni ago wawa te wamunoya.
O ema mamai, nikare asini nisokare emo dubara dumi pumuwo. Tini gamai numorekare oko wawe.
O mai bama dirire matere, nikare mia mama ge sara te dimuwo. Ago wawa Tua meni gai ewanana wamunoya.
O mamana, mai awiso nisokare iwoka wai azu, nikare wama nusokare oko ziawe.
Soumaire ema tuare amira ge.

O soumai, nikare zebura ema tua nisokarera ge dimuro baitiwo. Nukare nikare ua inuara be amire gege bua oko wawe. Uzutai ema inowera ago ine oko wawe. Nikare Tua nasokai azu inoise duba opi sai tepo meni nukare sou wewo.
Bua nisokare bamubamu awa erama emo kota, Tua emo wero duba peure ziwo.
Sou bua nusokare inoise ego kotumuwo: Nikare Tua Kristo sou inowewa, are nu nena dubu nusore potamu sero sianiro potinu itewia, awa bua nisokarera ina waise nimorekare dai potamunoya awa.
Zo nu bua nuso wai waya wamunoya, awa ina da ago ine waya pumamunoya. Nera kota, nakai Anutu uzutai ninai ine tepo.
